// diagnostic

E1116

A shared value has no `.{method}(…)` method

What

A shared value has no `.{method}(…)` method

Why

A shared value reads and writes like a value: a field read is one locked read, a field write is one locked write, and each statement is one atomic step.

Fix

Read the field directly (`config.name`) and write it directly (`config.hits += 1`); group several steps under `#Transact {{ … }}`, or take an expert guard with `.guard_edit()`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1116: tests/ui/shared_retired_closure_access.stderr.

Error [jet.UnknownSharedMethod]: A shared value has no `.read(…)` method
  --> tests/ui/shared_retired_closure_access.jet:7:18
    |
  7 |     print(config.read(fn(value) { value.hits }))
    |                  ^^^^
